title: Ply De-shuttering Breakage Problem

segments.vo: Ply de-shuttering ke waqt aise toot jati hai?
Tukde zameen par bikhre hain aur sheet bekaar ho gayi.
Kone mein padi yeh sari sheets phool kar kharab hain.
Aise kharab ply ka ab kya solution hai?
Ye hai VAJRA PP shuttering sheet, ek aadmi aaram se utha leta hai.

caption:
Har de-shuttering pe ply toot kar bekaar ho jati hai? Ab naya tareeka apnane ka waqt aa gaya hai.

Slab aur beam casting ke liye ab use kijiye waterproof PP shuttering sheet. Sahi handling ke saath ply se 2-3 guna zyada chalti hai aur har dhalai ka kharcha ply se kam hota hai.

Apne thekedar / mistri ko bhejo.
